1. saṃ-vát, f. (V.) side;
 region, tract.

 🞄sts. in the year of the reign of.

saṃketa‿udyāna, n. garden appointed 🞄as a rendezvous.

2. saṃ-gá, m. (coming together), conflict 🞄(RV.).
saṃga-ṭa, m. [-ṭa = bhaṭa] N..

saṃ-gupti, f. protection;

saṃgha‿ārāma, m. Buddhistic 🞄monastery.

saṃ-cákṣ-e, d. inf. (RV.);

 -vāja, a. acquiring or 🞄bestowing gain (RV.²).

saná-ya, a. old (RV.).

sá-nara, a. together with men (RV.¹);
 🞄-narma-hāsa, a. accompanied with jocular 🞄laughter.

sána-śruta, pp. long known, famed 🞄of old (RV.);

sanā́t, V. ad. (ab. of sána) from of 🞄old;

sa-nigaḍa-caraṇa, a. having 🞄a chain on oneʼs foot: -tva, n. abst. ɴ..

sán-i-tṛ, (± ac., -tṛ́, + g.) a. (V.) 🞄gaining;

san-u-tṛ, only f. sánutrī, winning, 🞄procuring (RV.).

sá-nemi, a. provided with a felly 🞄(RV.¹);

 🞄RV.).

saṃdhi‿akṣara, n. vowel produced 🞄by Saṃdhi, diphthong.
saṃdhyā-ya, den. Ā. resemble twilight: 🞄pp. i-ta.
sanna-musala: lc. when the pestle 🞄lies motionless.

san-nimitta, n. good omen;
 good 🞄cause: -m, ad. for a good cause.
sannī-kṛ, satisfy.
